content: On the English set, the RMSE is 0.78, and on Estonian 0.89. These numbers show that style transfer generally happens in the right direction, but is not very strong. Of the 55 sentences in English that were different from their source sentences, in 33 cases the sign of the average human score matched the desired one, in 7 it did not, and in 15 no change in style was observed by humans. In Estonian 36 sentences showed the right direction of style transfer, 10 wrong, and 22 no change.
